title: Input validation and claim spans
acceptance: Accept 10000 characters and retain exact offsets; exclude nonfacts; empty list when none

title: Trusted graph and text adapters
acceptance: Query graph and corpus; four verdicts; cite every supported or contradicted claim

title: Source deadlines and graceful degradation
acceptance: Timeout one source without preventing other evidence from returning

title: Scoring flags and severity
acceptance: Bound scores to zero through one; apply configured threshold and aggregate severity

title: Authenticated integration API
acceptance: Hash bearer keys; expose OpenAPI; enforce key rate limit and Retry-After

title: Dashboard verification workspace
acceptance: Submit text and inspect color-coded claim evidence with explicit empty states

title: Corrections with preserved original
acceptance: Only suggest a correction above alternative confidence 0.7; never rewrite original

title: Reviewer override and approval
acceptance: Store reviewer reason timestamp and original verdict; persist approval and audit

title: Filtered analytics and history
acceptance: Filter date and app/key; use effective overrides; show rates and report counts

title: Admin source policy and access control
acceptance: Only administrators edit weights timeouts keys; log all configuration changes

title: Claim cache and performance
acceptance: Reuse duplicates; invalidate on config; measure cached latency and 20-way concurrency

title: Automated tests and CI review
acceptance: Test on every PR; run static and dependency security checks; require human review

title: PostgreSQL container and HTTPS deployment
acceptance: Persistent PostgreSQL; Docker build; document reverse-proxy TLS and secure cookies

title: Documentation traceability and demos
acceptance: Reconcile deviations; map all requirements; record authentic sprint demos
